en.d.title: What does a percentage mean?
en.d.text: Percent means “out of 100”. So 50% means 50 out of every 100.
en.d.s1: To turn “3 out of 4” into a percentage, make the 4 into 100. 4 × 25 = 100. (“×” means “times”.)
en.d.s2: Do the same to the 3: 3 × 25 = 75. So 3 out of 4 is 75 out of 100, which is 75%.
en.d.s3: 100% means all of them. 0% means none of them.
en.d.q: A machine reads 2 out of 4 numbers correctly. What percentage is that?
en.d.fb: 2% would mean 2 out of 100. Here it is 2 out of 4. Make the 4 into 100 first: 4 × 25 = 100.
en.d.fc: 24 puts the digits 2 and 4 side by side. Make the 4 into 100: 4 × 25 = 100. Now do 2 × 25.
en.d.explain: 4 × 25 = 100 and 2 × 25 = 50. So 2 out of 4 is 50 out of 100, which is 50%.

hi.d.title: प्रतिशत का मतलब क्या है?
hi.d.text: प्रतिशत का मतलब है “100 में से”। तो 50% का मतलब है हर 100 में से 50।
hi.d.s1: “4 में से 3” को प्रतिशत में बदलने के लिए 4 को 100 बनाइए। 4 × 25 = 100। (“×” का मतलब “गुणा”।)
hi.d.s3: 100% का मतलब है सब। 0% का मतलब है एक भी नहीं।
hi.d.q: एक मशीन 4 में से 2 नंबर सही पढ़ती है। यह कितने प्रतिशत है?
hi.d.fc: 24 में 2 और 4 के अंक पास-पास रख दिए गए हैं। 4 को 100 बनाइए: 4 × 25 = 100। अब 2 × 25 कीजिए।

te.d.title: శాతం అంటే ఏమిటి?
te.d.q: ఒక యంత్రం 4 అంకెలలో 2 సరిగ్గా చదువుతుంది. అది ఎంత శాతం?
